pages.text: $(italic)Natural inhabitants of the deep, Merlings breathe and thrive beneath the waves.$()$(br2)$(bold)Origin Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Amphibious$() — $(item)Breathe underwater naturally$(). Swim faster and see clearly beneath the waves.$(br2)$(bold)Aqua Affinity$() — Boosted movement and mining speed underwater.$(br2)$(bold)Land Weakness$() — $(warn)Staying dry for more than 5 minutes leaves you sluggish and gasping.$() Stay near water.
